sip-calls-and-text.mock_limitation: Carrier media and acoustic behavior require the assembled phone.

serial-reconnect-and-role-routing.mock_limitation: Native USB CDC enumeration requires the real controllers.

keypad-display-coins-cards-hooks.mock_limitation: Electrical and mechanical behavior requires the assembled controls.

audio-generation-and-playback.mock_limitation: Acoustic intelligibility requires the installed transducers.

ab-operating-system-ota.mock_limitation: VideoCore tryboot selection requires a Zero 2 W.

readonly-root-and-persistent-state.mock_limitation: Final mount behavior must be observed from the physical image.

wifi-onboarding-recovery-and-privacy.mock_limitation: Broadcom RF and native client association are physical.

captive-portal-outside-guest.mock_limitation: Native captive detector UI requires each named client platform.

reverse-maintenance-tunnel.mock_limitation: The final source-network audit must use a genuinely external network.

monitoring-alerting-and-backup.mock_limitation: Deployed alert delivery and retention require production operations.

story-branches-persistence-and-accessibi.mock_limitation: Discoverability and engagement require first-time callers.

factory-seed-recovery-media-and-key-cust.mock_limitation: Media boot and separate offline custody require physical devices.

power-network-and-update-interruptions.mock_limitation: Measured rail collapse and brownout require installed-load instrumentation.

production-image-userspace.mock_limitation: Board firmware, SD, USB, and power behavior are not modeled by QEMU virt.

sip-carrier-audio.pass_criteria: A real carrier call rings, answers, carries intelligible two-way audio, hangs up, and leaves SIP healthy.
sip-carrier-audio.time_bound: One inbound and one outbound call, each observed for at least 30 seconds.

native-usb-cdc.pass_criteria: Alpha and Beta retain distinct attested roles through both attach orders, disconnect/reconnect, and one reset each with no cross-routing.
native-usb-cdc.time_bound: Each transition must recover within the configured serial reconnect deadline.

assembled-controls.pass_criteria: Handset, keypad, VFD, coin validator, and available token/card reader each produce the expected visible action without dropped or duplicated input.
assembled-controls.time_bound: Ten consecutive operations per installed control.

acoustic-path.pass_criteria: Ringer, handset speaker, and microphone are intelligible at configured owner volume with no clipping, feedback, or missing channel.
acoustic-path.time_bound: Observe each path continuously for at least 30 seconds.

pi-tryboot-ab.pass_criteria: A healthy candidate commits in both A-to-B and B-to-A directions; every injected failed boot returns to the previously committed slot without network access.
pi-tryboot-ab.time_bound: Commit only after the configured bounded health gate; fallback on the next firmware boot.

pi-persistent-partition.pass_criteria: Root and both inactive system filesystems are read-only while every declared persistent identity/state path is writable from partition 7 and survives reboot.
pi-persistent-partition.time_bound: Verify before service acceptance and again after one cold boot.

radio-client-matrix.pass_criteria: Real iOS, Android, macOS, and Windows clients complete wrong-password, hidden, open-warning, WPA2, transition-mode, recovery, and rollback cases without exposing administrative services or stored credentials.
radio-client-matrix.time_bound: Setup AP expires at 15 minutes; each successful station handoff completes within the production retry bound.

native-captive-detectors.pass_criteria: Each named platform's native detector opens the portal, renders it, establishes a protected session, and exports matching privacy-preserving acceptance evidence.
native-captive-detectors.time_bound: One fresh native probe and completed submission per platform during the same AP session.

external-network-maintenance.pass_criteria: A hardware-backed interactive login through the known domain succeeds from an egress distinct from the home network and can read healthy phone state without inbound home exposure.
external-network-maintenance.time_bound: Sustain the interactive session beyond the configured SSH failure window.

deployed-monitoring.pass_criteria: Production check-in, SIP, tunnel, OTA, serial, reset, disk, filesystem, certificate, and reboot signals are current; alert and restore-verified backup paths succeed.
deployed-monitoring.time_bound: Observe at least one metrics interval and one complete scheduled backup/verification cycle.

first-time-caller-playtest.pass_criteria: At least two first-time callers complete the primary experience uncoached; repeat, invalid-input, timeout, interruption, offline, optional-input, and return-visit cases have passing records.
first-time-caller-playtest.time_bound: Each participant receives only the prescribed neutral invitation and completes in the experience's declared duration.

recovery-media-boot.pass_criteria: An OS-identified removable card matches the signed expanded digest after full readback and cold-boots the production Zero 2 W without using a rejected artifact.
recovery-media-boot.time_bound: Verify the complete image length, then reach the bounded boot health gate once.

offline-key-copies.pass_criteria: Separate package and catalog keys each have two encrypted copies on physically distinct media; every read-only recovery derives the expected public identity and completes sign/verify.
offline-key-copies.time_bound: Complete all four copy/recovery records in the same custody ceremony before publication.

measured-power-matrix.pass_criteria: Measured idle, call, ring, coin, controlled-brownout, download, MCU-flash, activation, and arbitrary-loss cases preserve the last committed bootable state and record rail minima and reset causes.
measured-power-matrix.time_bound: Interrupt every named durable journal boundary and observe recovery through the bounded health gate.

zero2w-boot.pass_criteria: The exact signed candidate cold-boots on a Zero 2 W with native SD, RTL8153, both MCUs, daemon, audio, SIP, controls, update origin, and reverse tunnel healthy before commit.
zero2w-boot.time_bound: Remain healthy through the complete 125-second maintenance-tunnel gate.
